messages:
Liam: Heads up — planning to cut v2.7.0 tag in ~30m. Please confirm final artifacts uploaded and checksum ok. Changelog updated? Any last-minute cherry-picks to include? I'll annotate the tag and draft the GH release once green.

Maya: Changelog updated and pushed to release-branch: added upgrade notes for kv-cache behavior. Needs light copy-editing.

Sara: Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-releases/v2.7.0/ — checksums below:
```
sha256(servo-linux-x86_64.tar.gz)= a3f9b4d2e11f7c9a2b4d1e9f8c2a1e12f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c
sha256(backend-wheel-2.7.0.whl)= b7c2d1f3a9e6c4b2d1f0a9e8c7b6a5d4c3b2a1f0e9d8c7b6a5d4c3b2a1f0e9a
``` 
CI verified sizes and checksums.

Jordan: Running quick integr tests now. Saw a flake in quant test  — reproducing locally. Not a blocker but calling it out.

Theo: Small bugfix PR #4567 (routing policy default) — want to include. I can cherry-pick to release-branch now.

Liam: If it's low-risk and covered by unit tests, include. Post commit hash after you push.

Theo: Pushed cherry-pick, commit c3f9b2a. Ran smoke, e2e passed locally.

deploy-bot: artifact-upload complete for v2.7.0 (CI pipeline 7321). Checksums verified: OK :white_check_mark:

Maya: For release notes, please use annotated tag and include this short template in the GH draft:
```
Title: v2.7.0 — inference runtime & routing fixes
Notes:
- Fix: default routing policy enforcement (PR #4567)
- Improvement: KV-cache upgrade note
- Internal: bump runtime + packaging
Known-issues: quantization warn on old drivers
```
Attach binaries and the SHA sums.

Liam: Tagging commands I'm going to run:
```
git checkout release-branch
git tag -a v2.7.0 -m "v2.7.0 — annotated release (cherry-pick c3f9b2a)"
gpg --detach-sign -a v2.7.0
git push origin v2.7.0
```
I'll then create a GitHub draft release and attach artifacts.

Liam: After draft is ready I'll ping @release-coordinator and @Jordan for final publish. Who can publish the GH release when ready?

Jordan: I can publish. I'll wait for the draft and verify assets are attached and checksums match.

Maya: I'll do a quick pass on the notes once the draft is up. If all good, Jordan can hit publish.

Liam: Plan: cut annotated tag now (in ~5m), push signed tag, upload assets, create GH draft — Jordan publishes after Maya signoff. Timeout: if any regression within 1h we'll roll back the tag and revert cherry-pick. :thumbsup:

Jordan: ACK. Monitoring CI and smoke now.

Maya: Thanks all — tagging away.
